rows.label: Eighteen credits of psychology coursework (no AP or exam credit)
rows.note: Read as 18 credits in PSYCH courses, which is stricter than the page (a cross-listed course taken under another subject is not counted here). Independent study and research (PSYCH 4700, 4710) supply at most 6 credits. First-year writing seminars never count, and the board leaves out any course titled as one. AP and other exam credit are left out.

rows.label: Do not count a first-year writing seminar toward the minor, even a psychology one
rows.note: The board leaves out first-year writing seminars on its own. The page bars writing seminars and AP credit from the 18 credits. The board is stricter in two ways: it also leaves out IB, A-Level, international and placement exam credit, and it counts only courses taken under the PSYCH code. Ask the psychology department if you want such credit or a cross-listed course to count.

rows.label: Take every minor course for a letter grade (only PSYCH 4700 and 4710 may be S/U)
Earn a C- or better in each course that counts
Admission: be in good standing with three psychology courses at C+ or better (two for provisional admission)
Submit the psychology minor application form to get an advisor
